bayts.text: Indeed, truly: I praise the Best of Benefactors (Allah), and I do not complain to creatures of the loss of graces.
Whoever thought me, in my exile, one who abases himself before other than the Enricher, the All-Embracing (Allah), has truly become blind.
To Him I complain of my weakness, my poverty and my exile, and I hope for my return, soon, (as) the best of those favoured.
I complained to Him of my helplessness, and He put an end to my complaint, and He has been for me with what surpassed my expectation: He is the most generous of those who honour.
Those whom their disbelief in Him deceived made their way toward my side; but from them He protected me, driving away every criminal.
To Him be gratitude from me, hoping from Him for my request without burden on my part; and already my debt has vanished.
If he whom suspicion deceived, (moved) by envy, has deceived me, He Who led me with munificence has (never) deceived me.
And whoever casts me into the sea, out of denial, into desolation — then in the sea the generosity of the One Who honours has come to me.
And whoever was grieved by my being a worshipper of my Lord and my being servant of the foremost Intercessor (Muḥammad),
(let him know that) I am, for Him, on land and on sea, a worshipper, servant of the one who saves from the causes of regret.
And whoever turned away from me — then the gifts have come forth from the All-Embracing, the Enricher, the Preserver, the One Who brings forward (Allah).
And whoever casts me into the sea, aiming at my exile, (let him know that) for me, from my God, (there is) the garden in every deep sea.
To my Lord (goes) my refuge, in my presence and in my absence; and through the Chosen One (Muḥammad) I complain to Him: what an excellent ladder!
Upon him be the blessing of Allah, then His peace, with his Family and the Companions, together with every Muslim.
My God, upon the Best of creatures, Muḥammad, make the purest blessing endure forever, and grant him peace,
together with the Family and the Companions, all of them; and bring me back swiftly to Ṭūbā (Touba), encompass me (with Your protection) and teach me.
My God, (let there be) upon me, forever, my being his servant and my being servant of the Verses (of the Qurʾān): teach me and make me understand.
My God, from the Bestower (Al-Wahhāb) I seek depth of knowledge, unveiling and inspiration: so unveil for me and inspire me.
I have turned to the Opener (Al-Fattāḥ), seeking His openings, and I hope for outpourings from (Him), and the outpouring delights.
I am well pleased with the Subduer (Al-Qahhār), since He tamed the enemies for me, (I) a stranger, alone among them: what an enigma (to them)!
I shall please Him with the Qurʾān, in gratitude to Him through it, for my graces, with heart, body and mouth.
Upon me, for Him, is perseverance in what He has chosen for me as right guidance; and I please Him with the Verses, since they have become my spoil.
My gratitude, my contentment and my praise (go) to a Benefactor (An-Nāfiʿ) Who brought me a mighty, venerated Qurʾān.
It is the treasure and the clear Light through which, from the Fire, from enemies and from disgrace, we take shelter.
A mighty Book, from a Mighty One (Al-ʿAzīz): a mighty, trustworthy one (Gabriel) brought it to the mighty one who brings to completion (Muḥammad).
A noble Book, from a Generous One (Al-Karīm) Who honours, for a noble servant, a rescuer, full of mercy (Muḥammad).
